title: Actual order-three extension defects and the canonical original pants candidate
proved_results: The specified actual M=<F,Theta,Omega> is C2(tau) amalg C3(xi), with the full generator maps and kernel/quotient inverse maps proved.
For each full unit nu, the actual gamma_nu=beta chi_nu retains both original involution equations, the original z cusp, and the exact image w^(-1)<z,g>w.
The three original-F words N, R_x and R_y give a homeomorphism between their simultaneous zero set and the pairs (nu,Phi) of actual M endomorphisms extending gamma_nu on G_+.
The literal abelian projection of R_y forces nu=m for epsilon=+1 and nu=-m for epsilon=-1, where the fixed original m=a-b is -1 modulo four. No full-unit consequence is inferred.
Projection of the full extension-defect zero set to nu is a homeomorphism onto the original D74.40 parameter set T. Both directions retain the same original h and the exact r,g,w choices.
The reverse map uses the displayed unique g_nu,w_nu transporters on the two clopen mod-four branches and the explicit full cyclic norm extension rho_M.
The original word W=w^(-1)z^b g w x^(-m) lies in F prime and gives the exact identity T={epsilon m: epsilon=+1 or -1, m in Zhat units, W=1}. Neither gate is proved for a remaining input.
On the exact domain m in Zhat units and W=1, the complete original conjugator fibers are w^(-1)z^lambda and x^(-m)w^(-1)z^lambda, with the specified continuous inverse character coordinate.
For the original standard h=1, g=x^(-1),w=x,m=-1, both genuine extensions and original parameters -1,+1 are recovered by exact word substitution.
